LengthDays.description: Rolling: window length in days (exclusive lower bound).

LengthMonths.description: Rolling: window length in calendar months (clamped subtraction: 31 Jul − 1mo = 30 Jun).

Period.description: Calendar: the period containing the as-of date, period start → as-of.

AnchorDateField.description: SinceEvent/RenewalRelative: the per-record date column the window anchors on.

OffsetDays.description: SinceEvent/RenewalRelative: offset applied to the anchor date.

EmitPresence.description: Also emit <column>__present (the hadData mask distinguishing a real zero from absence).
